terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.section1Body: Media Roulette is a casual party game. It randomly selects photos and videos from the devices of players in a room and shows them to everyone so they can guess who took them.
terms.section2Body: You are fully responsible for the media stored on your device and for what you choose to show in the game. Do not use content that is illegal, offensive, harmful, or that you do not have the right to share.
terms.section3Body: Photos and videos are only shared after you confirm your selection. They are resized and re-encoded on your phone first, which also removes location and camera metadata. The game server keeps them only while your game runs and shares them only with the players in your room. They are deleted when the game ends, when you leave the game, or after 15 minutes of inactivity.
terms.section4Body: Multiplayer games use an online connection to sync players, scores and game state. Do not attempt to cheat, disrupt games, or attack the service or other players.
terms.section5Body: Media Roulette is provided “as is” without any guarantees. Use it at your own risk. The developer cannot be held liable for any loss, damage or issues arising from the use of the app.
terms.disclaimer: This text is a general description and may not cover all legal requirements in your country. For full legal compliance, please have it reviewed by a qualified lawyer.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.section1Body: The app reads your photo and video library only to pick random media for the game. Nothing is shared until you confirm your selection (in Blind mode, photos are picked and shared automatically). Selected media are compressed on your device before upload, and location and camera metadata are removed.
privacy.section2Body: We may store limited technical data such as game room IDs, usernames, scores and timestamps needed for gameplay. We do not build advertising profiles and we do not sell your data.
privacy.section3Body: During a game, your username, answers, scores and selected media are shared with the other players in the same room. Media are stored temporarily on the game server, are only accessible to players of that room, and are deleted when the game ends, when you leave, or after 15 minutes of inactivity. Each player's phone also keeps a temporary copy until the game ends.
privacy.section4Body: You can revoke photo and video permissions at any time in your device settings. In the app settings you can also exclude specific albums so they are never used in the game.
privacy.section5Body: We use standard technical measures to protect data in transit between players and the server. However, no online service can be 100% secure, and you should avoid using the app on untrusted networks.
privacy.disclaimer: This policy is a simplified explanation of how the app handles data and may not cover all legal requirements in your country. For full legal compliance, please have it reviewed by a qualified lawyer.

permissionInfo.title: How your photos are used
permissionInfo.point1: The game picks random photos and videos from your library.

permissionInfo.point3: Only the ones chosen for the game are shared, end-to-end encrypted.
permissionInfo.point4: Hold your own photo during a round to hide it. Everything is deleted after the game.
